en.title: for Starlink Mini Car Adapter Supports 105W Power, Features Boost Module, for Starlink Mini Cable Continuous and Stable Output, 12/24V Step Up to 30V 3.5A Conversion Kit, with 9.8FT DC Cable IP68
en.description_html:
About this item

Built-in Boost Module: This starlink mini 12V adapter converts 10V-28V step up to 30V 3.5A stable power, preventing disconnects while driving.

Compatible with Multiple Plugs: This Starlink mini power supply cable has multiple plugs, including USB-C, car plug, and DC-DC, allowing for easy and quick replacement of various adapters.

Full Protection: The starlink mini 12v adapter features over-current, over-heat, short-circuit, and under-voltage protection with cool operation.

Weatherproof Build: This starlink mini charger has an IP68 waterproof, UV-resistant, and -40°C-rated cord for outdoor reliability.

Wide Compatibility: This starlink mini cable works with 10V/12V/24V28V pulg systems, for Car, RVs, trucks, and boats.
